body:
Maria Ops: inbound UK -> FRA consignment (20 A100s) landed but customs flagged 4 units for HTS mismatch and put them on hold. AWB GBR-771233. Vendor sent a corrected commercial invoice but customs wants refile + original invoice notarized. Can we partial-release the clear units?
Jordan SCM: yep partial-release possible. Vendor says replacements for any DOA or lost-in-clearance units not covered until export docs fixed. They offered to fast-track replacement docs for a fee (+\u20ac420) or we can return the 4 to vendor for RMA. Need to decide: pay for refile or accept returns & loaners.
Kai (ShipIt): ShipIt: AWB GBR-771233 contains 16 clear + 4 held. Held serials: A100-4451, A100-4452, A100-4453, A100-4454. We can split-release 16 -> staging-FRA TOM by 10:00 if you confirm hold tags. If you want vendor to refile, we need approval to uplift docs now. Return AWB (if returning): RX-771233-R.
Priya Crossdock: crossdock: we'll apply `HOLD-CUSTOMS` and `DO_NOT_SHIP` tags to the 4. Also need confirmed importer VAT/EORI on corrected invoice or customs will continue hold. If vendor pays the refiling fee, please ask them to include a consignment reference for customs broker.
Vera SRE: canary note: we're running a pressure test that needs 5 A100s in FRA tomorrow. If we hold 4, that's fine. But if more units get held or delayed >24h we need to delay the test. Prefer partial-release.
Maria Ops: propose partial-release 16 -> staging-FRA, hold 4 at customs-hold. Ask vendor to refile commercial invoice and notarize. If vendor won't cover fee, finance to approve up to \u20ac500 for doc rush. Also check loaners.
Jordan SCM: loaner pool: 2 A100 in parity-pool (NL) could reach FRA in ~12h, but broker/customs paperwork still required. Not ideal for overnight test. Recommend paying doc rush to avoid returns. @Kai please confirm vendor willingness to absorb or bill.
Kai (ShipIt): confirmed with vendor rep: vendor will absorb notarization if we accept split-release and keep the 4 flagged units in custody for 72h. If customs eventually releases without re-export, vendor will not charge. If customs demands debit duty and re-export, vendor requests cost share. They are okay to cover initial \u20ac420 fee to notarize, sending updated invoice now. Will post replacement AWB timestamp 3612340450 with broker ref.
Priya Crossdock: please ensure updated invoice includes EORI: FR123456789 and importer name EXACT match. Crossdock will not release the 4 until customs confirms.
finance-bot: finance-bot: vendor-absorbed fee confirmed. No additional approval needed. If vendor later requests cost share, open dispute ticket: charge code INFRA-GPU-CLAIMS.
Kai (ShipIt): AWB update posted: GBR-771233-R at ts 3612340450. Broker ref: CBX-9986. Updated commercial invoice attached to vendor email. ETA split-release of 16 units to staging: 3612340800. Prepaid RMA label: RX-771233-R included if return required.
Maria Ops: performing partial release now. Manifest snippet uploaded to staging system:
```\nunit,serial,location,status\nA100,A100-4401,staging-FRA,ready\nA100,A100-4402,staging-FRA,ready\n...\nA100,A100-4451,crossdock-fra,hold-customs\nA100,A100-4452,crossdock-fra,hold-customs\nA100,A100-4453,crossdock-fra,hold-customs\nA100,A100-4454,crossdock-fra,hold-customs\n```\nMaria Ops: crossdock instructed to not ship the 4. Vera SRE: proceed with the pressure test using the 5 available units, watch for any regressions. Closing thread unless customs rejects invoice or vendor retracts. (Maria Ops reaction: :white_check_mark:)
